name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A popup that displays information related to an element when it receives keyboard focus or the mouse hovers over it.

parts.name: trigger
parts.description: Trigger render-prop — typically the element the tooltip describes.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: The close delay of the tooltip.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether the tooltip should close on click

props.name: closeOnEscape
props.description: Whether to close the tooltip when the Escape key is pressed.

props.name: closeOnPointerDown
props.description: Whether to close the tooltip on pointerdown.

props.name: closeOnScroll
props.description: Whether the tooltip should close on scroll

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the tooltip when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the tooltip.

props.name: defaultTriggerValue
props.description:
The initial trigger value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the trigger value.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the tooltip. Useful for composition.

props.name: interactive
props.description:
Whether the tooltip's content is interactive.
In this mode, the tooltip will remain open when user hovers over the content.

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the tooltip

props.name: openDelay
props.description: The open delay of the tooltip.

props.name: positioning
props.description: The user provided options used to position the popover content

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Function called when the tooltip is opened.

events.name: onTriggerValueChange
events.description: Function called when the trigger value changes.

accessibilityNotes: The trigger's `aria-describedby` points at the tooltip content only while it's open, so assistive tech announces the description without adding permanent DOM noise.
The content renders `role="tooltip"` unless the trigger already carries an `aria-label`, in which case the label is the accessible name and the role is omitted to avoid redundant announcements.
Opens on trigger focus as well as hover, so keyboard-only users can reach tooltip content by tabbing to the trigger — no pointer required.
Closes on `Escape` (`closeOnEscape`, default `true`) and on scroll (`closeOnScroll`, default `true`); set `closeOnPointerDown={false}` if the tooltip should survive a click on the trigger.

examples.title: Basic
examples.source:
import Tooltip from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tooltip/tooltip.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";

<Tooltip content="Add to library">
  <@trigger|props|>
    <Button type="button" ...props variant="outline">Hover me</Button>
  </@trigger>
</Tooltip>
examples.description: The `trigger` render-prop receives the machine's trigger attributes — spread them onto whatever element the tooltip describes.

examples.title: Positioning
examples.source:
import Tooltip from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tooltip/tooltip.marko"; import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";
<@trigger|props|> <@trigger|props|> <@trigger|props|> <@trigger|props|>
examples.description: Pass `positioning={ placement: "top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left" }` to control where the tooltip renders relative to its trigger.

examples.title: Custom delay
examples.source:
import Tooltip from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tooltip/tooltip.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";

<Tooltip content="Appears quickly" openDelay=0 closeDelay=0>
  <@trigger|props|>
    <Button type="button" ...props variant="outline">No delay</Button>
  </@trigger>
</Tooltip>
examples.description: Set `openDelay` and `closeDelay` (in milliseconds) to change how quickly the tooltip appears and disappears.

examples.title: With Keyboard Shortcut
examples.description: Compose `Kbd` inside the tooltip's body to show a keyboard shortcut alongside the tooltip text.

examples.title: RTL
examples.source:
import Tooltip from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/tooltip/tooltip.marko"; import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";
<@trigger|props|> <@trigger|props|> <@trigger|props|> <@trigger|props|>
examples.description: Set `dir="rtl"` on the `Tooltip` (matching the surrounding document direction) so the positioner flips placement automatically.

composition: `Tooltip` is a single component, not three. Where upstream composes `Tooltip` / `TooltipTrigger` / `TooltipContent`, this port folds trigger and content into `Tooltip` itself: the `@trigger` render-prop receives the machine's trigger attributes to spread onto whatever element the tooltip describes, and `content` (a string prop, or the tag's own body) supplies what's shown when open. There is no separate `TooltipTrigger` or `TooltipContent` tag to import.
